run_single_point_orca: run a single-point energy and gradient calculation using ORCA with a given Atoms object
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run a geometry optimization using ORCA via QUACC with ASE atoms and custom optimizer parameters
run_orca_with_nbo: run an ORCA single-point calculation with Natural Bond Orbital analysis enabled via the nbo flag
run_orca_metal_organics: run an ORCA calculation with symmetry breaking for metal-organic systems using the vertical MetalOrganics setting
run_orca_parallel: run an ORCA single-point or optimization calculation parallelized across a specified number of CPU cores
